11.description: A proposal to rezone 1401 11th Street West in Holiday Park for a six-unit dwelling was not approved by Council, despite a unanimous first reading.

chips.text: Municipal Planning Commission voted 6-4 against denying the rezoning, supporting infill development.
Residents within 150 meters of 1401 11th Street West.
Administration recommended denial, citing non-alignment with infill policies.
Administration warned approval could set a precedent for other large corner sites.
Applicant could not confirm if the project would proceed with only four units.
69 of 75 residents expressed concerns about increased density and neighborhood character.

12.description: This item proposes rezoning 902-938 3rd Avenue North from light industrial to corridor residential, allowing higher density development. Council held a public hearing on the proposal.

chips.text: No public comments or concerns were received regarding the rezoning application.

13.description: Saskatoon is considering closing a lane in the 1000 block University Drive, transferring it to Ronald McDonald House to improve guest safety, with the applicant covering all costs.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer questioned rear lane access for waste trucks and moving vans.
Ronald McDonald House will pay all costs for the lane closure and new construction.
Ronald McDonald House volunteer spoke in support, citing improved safety for families.
